Definition: something written, i.e. a writing, record or book
BiblicalUsage: A writing is a record or a book, and the king's letters were written in his name and sealed with his ring, and the book of truth holds the names of those who stand in the battle, and the priests sought their register among the writings and were put from the priesthood when they were not found. David received the pattern of the temple in writing from the hand of the Lord. The word holds the decree, the record, and the pattern together, and all three are written down so they will not be lost.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God writes things down because He wants us to remember, and the book of truth is still open. I hold that my name is written where it matters, and the writings of men will fade while His remain.
RelatedPeople: Queen Esther; Daniel; Ezra; King David
